description: Training label: 0=interictal/background, 1=preictal (last 15 min before a qualifying seizure onset, see preproc_utils.get_lbls_sz_epochs), 2=ictal/buffer (during a seizure; excluded from binary classification).

Subject ID. 3-digit numeric strings (e.g. '001'-'079') are Helsinki University Hospital (HUH) subjects; 4-digit IDs starting with '97' are Cork University Maternity Hospital subjects (remapped from 'ID...' by preproc.get_df_cork).

Running epoch index within a subject's recording. Each step = one 20-second QEEG epoch (computed over a 60-second sliding window internally; see qeegfeats baruto.yml len_epoch=60 / Windower window=20).
Data augmentation applied to this row's epoch: 'none', 'vertflip', 'horizflip', or 'horizvertflip' (left-right / polarity flips of the EEG montage used to expand the training set).

1 if this epoch falls in a 'safe' interictal stretch (>=20 min away from any seizure) usable for clean training labels; set via preproc_utils.get_lbls_sz_epochs. -2 marks augmentation-segment boundaries.
Segment group ID grouping epochs into interictal-to-seizure segments; encodes subject_id and a running segment counter (see preproc_utils.py snd_id = subject_id*1e6 + snd_grp).
Postnatal age (minutes) excluding time after the first seizure. Only populated for Cork subjects with known age-at-EEG metadata; NaN/0 for HUH subjects (age reference not available in this pipeline).
Postnatal age (minutes) at each epoch. Only populated for Cork subjects with known age-at-EEG metadata; NaN/0 for HUH subjects.
